title: Android Wear integration 'Enable Wear Collection Service' doesn't work
body:
Hi,

Watch -> Fossil Q4 Explorist (4th Gen) 
Wear OS 1.5
Android 8

I have the following wear integration settings turned on:

Android Wear Integration -> On
Enable Wear Collection Service -> On
Force Wear Collection Service -> Off
Rest settings default

When I walk away from my phone, or turn my phone off, I expect my watch to connect directly to the miaomiao, and then run xDrip standalone from the watch -- this doesn't happen. My xDrip watch face stays consistently incrementing the last reading text, showing that no new readings are made.

I seem to be unable to pair the miaomiao with the watch in the bluetooth settings (although it seems this is not required anyway).

Is there anything I can try to do to fix this?

comments.body:
I think only certain watches can br untethered from smartphone & collect readings independently like Sony SmartWatch 3.

However I'm not sure & don't know what watches do or don't untether. 

I'd appreciate some clarification my self.
